description: Use this when someone asks for the cheapest heating oil or kerosene in an Irish county or Eircode area, which oil supplier is cheapest, how much 300, 500 or 1000 litres costs today, or whether a price they were quoted is fair. Returns named oil suppliers ranked by published delivered price, cents per litre, observation time, the county average and an optional comparison with the quote. Republic of Ireland only. Do not use for Northern Ireland or Great Britain. Reference prices, not quotes or bookable offers.

litres.description: Order size. Prices are published for 300, 500 and 1000 litres. For another amount use the nearest size and say so.

location.description: An Irish county in any common form (Cork, Co. Cork, Corcaigh), a Dublin postal district (Dublin 15, D15), or the first three characters of an Eircode (T12). Do not send a street address.

quotedTotalEUR.description: The delivered total in euro, including VAT, that the household was quoted for this order size, to compare with published prices.

name: tankful_county_supplier_prices
title: Cheapest heating oil near a place
